data.title: Tiger Sky Tower
data.about:
Discover A New Launch in Business Bay! Tiger Sky Tower.
Tiger Sky Tower Business Bay is a stunning project from Tiger Properties, showcasing their flagship masterpiece. Highly recommended for its fully furnished, fitted apartments in the luxury towers district of Business Bay.

Tiger Sky Tower Business Bay is planned to be the world's highest rainforest, offering the most luxurious amenities. Property for sale at Tiger Sky Tower includes a variety of options: 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, as well as penthouses and a royal sky penthouse. Tiger Sky Tower Dubai features an iconic design, the highest infinity pool in the world, the highest restaurant in the world, thrilling adventure experiences, and fascinating amenities. With its epic design, excellent location, and scenic views, get ready to admire a future of utmost elegance in Business Bay, Dubai. As a symbol of luxury in Dubai, Tiger Sky Tower Apartments redefine opulence and comfort, elevating everyday life to new heights.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy an Adventurous Lifestyle at Tiger Sky Tower!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Tallest Residential Tower: The tallest residential tower in Dubai at 447 meters, featuring the world’s highest rainforest.
  • Iconic Design: Shimmering golden high-rise combining modern brilliance and Emirati heritage.`
  • Luxury Apartments: Tiger Sky Tower Apartments offer sleek, spacious layouts with premium finishes and panoramic city views.
  • Prime Location: Tiger Sky Tower Business Bay is centrally located in Dubai’s dynamic district.
  • Cultural Fusion: Honors Dubai’s rich tradition with cutting-edge architecture.
  • Versatile Layouts: Diverse floor plans catering to various needs, from intimate to expansive.
  • Top-tier Amenities: Includes luxury leisure and wellness facilities enhancing daily life.
  • New Launch: A highly anticipated addition to Business Bay’s skyline, promising exclusive living.
  • Elevated Living: Offers unparalleled luxury rooted in Emirati tradition, redefining urban living.

location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Located in the heart of Business Bay, Tiger Sky Tower epitomizes elevated living in Dubai. With its iconic design and breathtaking views, residents are treated to a world of luxury and sophistication. Tiger Sky Tower Business Bay offers an unparalleled residential experience amidst the bustling cityscape, boasting a range of premium amenities.

Discover the charm of Tiger Sky Tower Apartments, where elegance and comfort coexist in every detail. The streamlined appearance and imposing presence of Tiger Sky Tower capture the spirit of modern life in the city’s center.

  • Al Khail Road 2 Minutes
  • Dubai Canal 5 Minutes
  • Dubai Design District 8 Minutes
  • Dubai Fountain 13 Minutes
  • Dubai Mall 14 Minutes
  • Museum of The Future 15 Minutes
